info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Replace Banking Accounts Unfreeze-v3-spec
info.description: The Banking Accounts Unfreeze API allows financial institutions to process unfreeze requests for bank accounts. This functionality is essential for restoring access to accounts that have been temporarily frozen due to various reasons, such as suspicious activity or regulatory compliance. Users of this API typically include banking application developers and financial service providers that manage account status. By utilizing this API, businesses can streamline the process of unfreezing accounts, enhancing customer service and operational efficiency.

put.description: This endpoint allows you to remove the frozen status from an account, enabling it to perform transactions and other operations that were restricted while frozen.

requestBody.description: Request body for unfreezing a user account. This operation typically involves providing the necessary account details to remove restrictions on an account that has been previously frozen. Please ensure all required parameters are included.
